author: RealTimeMP Extension
name: RealTimeMP
shortDescription: Complete real-time multiplayer: rooms, player sync, custom events, RPC, chat, lobby — connect to any WebSocket server.

eventsFunctions.description: Connect to a WebSocket multiplayer server.
eventsFunctions.name: Connect

eventsFunctions.description: Disconnect from the server.
eventsFunctions.name: Disconnect

eventsFunctions.description: Create a new room. Optionally add a password and set it as private.
eventsFunctions.name: CreateRoom
eventsFunctions.sentence: Create room named _PARAM1_ max _PARAM2_ players (password: _PARAM3_, private: _PARAM4_)

eventsFunctions.description: Join an existing room by ID. Use the lobby to get room IDs.
eventsFunctions.name: JoinRoom

eventsFunctions.description: Leave the current room.
eventsFunctions.name: LeaveRoom

eventsFunctions.description: Request the list of available public rooms from the server. Use LobbyRoomCount() and LobbyRoomData() to read results.
eventsFunctions.name: RequestLobbyList

eventsFunctions.description: Send this player's position, angle, and custom data to all other players in the room. Call this every frame.
eventsFunctions.name: SendPlayerState
eventsFunctions.sentence: Send player state X:_PARAM1_ Y:_PARAM2_ Angle:_PARAM3_ Data:_PARAM4_

parameters.description: Custom data (JSON string or any string)
parameters.name: customData

eventsFunctions.description: Send a custom named event with data to other players. Leave target empty to broadcast to all in room.
eventsFunctions.name: SendCustomEvent
eventsFunctions.sentence: Send event _PARAM1_ with data _PARAM2_ to player _PARAM3_ (empty = all)

eventsFunctions.description: Mark the current custom event as processed and move to the next one.
eventsFunctions.name: FlushCustomEvent
eventsFunctions.sentence: Mark current custom event as handled

eventsFunctions.description: Call a named function on another player's game. Args must be a JSON array string e.g. '[1, "hello"]'.
eventsFunctions.name: CallRPC
eventsFunctions.sentence: Call RPC _PARAM1_ with args _PARAM2_ on player _PARAM3_ (empty = all)

eventsFunctions.description: Mark the current RPC call as processed.
eventsFunctions.name: FlushRPC
eventsFunctions.sentence: Mark current RPC call as handled

eventsFunctions.description: Set a shared room variable visible to all players.
eventsFunctions.name: SetRoomVariable

eventsFunctions.description: Send a chat message to all players in the room.
eventsFunctions.name: SendChatMessage

eventsFunctions.description: Mark the current chat message as read.
eventsFunctions.name: FlushChatMessage
eventsFunctions.sentence: Mark current chat message as read

eventsFunctions.description: Sync an object's state to all players. Only call from host.
eventsFunctions.name: SyncObject
eventsFunctions.sentence: Sync object _PARAM1_ at X:_PARAM2_ Y:_PARAM3_ Angle:_PARAM4_ Data:_PARAM5_

eventsFunctions.description: Kick a player from the room. Only works if you are the host.
eventsFunctions.name: KickPlayer

eventsFunctions.description: Check if disconnected.
